cond_0001.intro: We are looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer to join our team. The role primarily involves designing and developing new products, particularly focusing on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, etc. The successful candidate will ensure adherence to established design criteria guidelines to meet customer requirements. Effective communication and management of changes, deviations, and value analysis/value engineering (VA/VE) for products with customers are essential aspects of this role.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Design and develop new products within established design criteria guidelines to adapt Seating Products to Customer Requirements, with a specific focus on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, etc.
Communicate and manage Changes, Deviations, and VA/VE for Product with Customers.
Provide Design and Manage all Program Refreshes or New Programs for Product Design, Testing, and Samples to support a smooth launch with Customer.
Develop CAD generated solid models and engineering drawings in Catia V5. Provide CAD data to develop proof of principle models to verify design concepts for Heating, Heat/Cool, and Heat/Vent Systems, mechanisms, plastic, stampings, etc.
Test Designs and develop designs/corrective actions for insufficient areas of design.
Procure prototype product and capital costs as required.
Coordinate the testing of existing and new products to validate FMVSS and customer requirements.
Develop and maintain the DFMEA and DVPR for Programs and/or changes.
Continuously search for new processes and vendors that will enhance products, improve quality, and reduce costs for Electrical Control Units, Switches, Wiring Harness, Blowers, etc.
Apply value-added practices to current products, processes, methods, and materials to identify opportunities for cost/quality improvements.
Support quality and environmental systems and APQP standards in design engineering functions.
Support root cause analysis of quality issues and validate corrective actions when needed.
Coordinate cross-functional team activities between engineering and other departments.
Travel as needed to facilities, Suppliers, and Customer locations.
Maintain composure under stressful situations, communicate clearly and persuasively, and present numerical data effectively and accurately.
Respect cultural differences and promote a harassment-free environment, working with integrity and ethically following the [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures.
Prioritize and plan work activities efficiently, consistently arriving at work and meetings on time, and offering help when needed.
Lead others to work as a team to support projects and programs, demonstrating teamwork by collaborating with others to improve overall standards of performance and service.
Ability to work under tight timelines while managing multiple tasks and participate in projects while assuming additional tasks as assigned.
Identify and resolve problems in a timely manner, understanding root cause analysis to develop solutions to issues.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree (B.S.) in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) from a four-year college or university; and/or 2-5+ years' related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Basic understanding of APQP, PPAP, and continuous improvement such as Kaizen or 6-Sigma.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, and customers.
Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as stress analysis, kinematics, probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
Preferred Requirements
Automotive or related seat design experience.
Competency in CAD (preferably Catia V5).
Knowledge of CAD (Catia V5 preferred), AX, Mapics, and Microsoft Office software (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

cond_0023.intro: We are looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer to join our team. The role primarily involves designing and developing new products, particularly focusing on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, etc. The successful candidate will ensure adherence to established design criteria guidelines to meet customer requirements. Effective communication and management of changes, deviations, and value analysis/value engineering (VA/VE) for products with customers are essential aspects of this role. cond_0023.responsibilities:
Design and develop new products within established design criteria guidelines to adapt Seating Products to Customer Requirements, with a specific focus on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, etc.
Communicate and manage Changes, Deviations, and VA/VE for Product with Customers.
Provide Design and Manage all Program Refreshes or New Programs for Product Design, Testing, and Samples to support a smooth launch with Customer.
Develop CAD generated solid models and engineering drawings in Catia V5. Provide CAD data to develop proof of principle models to verify design concepts for Heating, Heat/Cool, and Heat/Vent Systems, mechanisms, plastic, stampings, etc.
Test Designs and develop designs/corrective actions for insufficient areas of design.
Procure prototype product and capital costs as required.
Coordinate the testing of existing and new products to validate FMVSS and customer requirements.
Develop and maintain the DFMEA and DVPR for Programs and/or changes.
Continuously search for new processes and vendors that will enhance products, improve quality, and reduce costs for Electrical Control Units, Switches, Wiring Harness, Blowers, etc.
Apply value-added practices to current products, processes, methods, and materials to identify opportunities for cost/quality improvements.
Support quality and environmental systems and APQP standards in design engineering functions.
Support root cause analysis of quality issues and validate corrective actions when needed.
Coordinate cross-functional team activities between engineering and other departments.
Travel as needed to facilities, Suppliers, and Customer locations.
Maintain composure under stressful situations, communicate clearly and persuasively, and present numerical data effectively and accurately.
Respect cultural differences and promote a harassment-free environment, working with integrity and ethically following the Company's policies and procedures.
Prioritize and plan work activities efficiently, consistently arriving at work and meetings on time, and offering help when needed.
Lead others to work as a team to support projects and programs, demonstrating teamwork by collaborating with others to improve overall standards of performance and service.
Ability to work under tight timelines while managing multiple tasks and participate in projects while assuming additional tasks as assigned.
Identify and resolve problems in a timely manner, understanding root cause analysis to develop solutions to issues.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Bachelor's degree (B.S.) in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) from a four-year college or university; and/or 2-5+ years' related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

cond_0045.intro: We are looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer to join our team. The role centers on collaborating with cross-functional teams to design and develop new products, with a focus on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, and related components. Together, the team works to ensure designs meet established guidelines and customer requirements. Coordinating on changes, deviations, and value analysis/value engineering (VA/VE) with customers is a key part of how this role operates.
cond_0045.responsibilities:
Work with the team to design and develop new products within established design criteria guidelines, adapting Seating Products to Customer Requirements, with a focus on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, etc.
Coordinate with customers to communicate and manage Changes, Deviations, and VA/VE for Products.
Support and manage all Program Refreshes or New Programs for Product Design, Testing, and Samples, working alongside relevant teams to help ensure a smooth customer launch.
Develop CAD solid models and engineering drawings in Catia V5. Share CAD data with the team to develop proof of principle models and verify design concepts for Heating, Heat/Cool, and Heat/Vent Systems, mechanisms, plastic, stampings, etc.
Test designs and work with others to develop corrective actions for insufficient areas of design.
Coordinate procurement of prototype product and capital costs as required.
Work with the team to test existing and new products to validate FMVSS and customer requirements.
Develop and maintain the DFMEA and DVPR for Programs and/or changes in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
Collaborate with suppliers and internal teams to identify new processes and vendors that will enhance products, improve quality, and reduce costs for Electrical Control Units, Switches, Wiring Harness, Blowers, etc.
Work with the team to apply value-added practices to current products, processes, methods, and materials to identify opportunities for cost/quality improvements.
Support quality and environmental systems and APQP standards in design engineering functions.
Assist in root cause analysis of quality issues and help validate corrective actions when needed.
Coordinate cross-functional team activities between engineering and other departments.
Travel as needed to facilities, Suppliers, and Customer locations.
Communicate clearly and persuasively, present numerical data effectively and accurately, and maintain composure under stressful situations.
Respect cultural differences and promote a harassment-free environment, working with integrity and ethically following [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures.
Plan and prioritize work activities efficiently, arrive at work and meetings on time, and offer help to others when needed.
Work alongside others as a team to support projects and programs, contributing to overall standards of performance and service.
Manage multiple tasks under tight timelines and participate in projects while taking on additional tasks as assigned.
Identify and resolve problems in a timely manner, working with the team to understand root causes and develop solutions.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0045.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree (B.S.) in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) from a four-year college or university; and/or 2-5+ years' related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Basic understanding of APQP, PPAP, and continuous improvement such as Kaizen or 6-Sigma.
Competency in CAD (preferably Catia V5).
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, and customers.
Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as stress analysis, kinematics, probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
Preferred Requirements
Automotive or related seat design experience.
Knowledge of AX, Mapics, and Microsoft Office software (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

cond_0081.intro: We are looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer to join our team. The role centers on collaborating with cross-functional teams to design and develop new products, with a focus on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, and related components. Together, the team works to ensure designs meet established guidelines and customer requirements. Coordinating on changes, deviations, and value analysis/value engineering (VA/VE) with customers is a key part of how this role operates.
cond_0081.responsibilities:
Work with the team to design and develop new products within established design criteria guidelines, adapting Seating Products to Customer Requirements, with a focus on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, etc.
Coordinate with customers to communicate and manage Changes, Deviations, and VA/VE for Products.
Support and manage all Program Refreshes or New Programs for Product Design, Testing, and Samples, working alongside relevant teams to help ensure a smooth customer launch.
Develop CAD solid models and engineering drawings in Catia V5. Share CAD data with the team to develop proof of principle models and verify design concepts for Heating, Heat/Cool, and Heat/Vent Systems, mechanisms, plastic, stampings, etc.
Test designs and work with others to develop corrective actions for insufficient areas of design.
Coordinate procurement of prototype product and capital costs as required.
Work with the team to test existing and new products to validate FMVSS and customer requirements.
Develop and maintain the DFMEA and DVPR for Programs and/or changes in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
Collaborate with suppliers and internal teams to identify new processes and vendors that will enhance products, improve quality, and reduce costs for Electrical Control Units, Switches, Wiring Harness, Blowers, etc.
Work with the team to apply value-added practices to current products, processes, methods, and materials to identify opportunities for cost/quality improvements.
Support quality and environmental systems and APQP standards in design engineering functions.
Assist in root cause analysis of quality issues and help validate corrective actions when needed.
Coordinate cross-functional team activities between engineering and other departments.
Travel as needed to facilities, Suppliers, and Customer locations.
Communicate clearly and persuasively, present numerical data effectively and accurately, and maintain composure under stressful situations.
Respect cultural differences and promote a harassment-free environment, working with integrity and ethically following [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures.
Plan and prioritize work activities efficiently, arrive at work and meetings on time, and offer help to others when needed.
Work alongside others as a team to support projects and programs, contributing to overall standards of performance and service.
Manage multiple tasks under tight timelines and participate in projects while taking on additional tasks as assigned.
Identify and resolve problems in a timely manner, working with the team to understand root causes and develop solutions.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0081.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree (B.S.) in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) from a four-year college or university; and/or 2-5+ years' related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Basic understanding of APQP, PPAP, and continuous improvement such as Kaizen or 6-Sigma.
Competency in CAD (preferably Catia V5).
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, and customers.
Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as stress analysis, kinematics, probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
Preferred Requirements
Automotive or related seat design experience.
Knowledge of AX, Mapics, and Microsoft Office software (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

The role primarily involves designing and developing new products, with a focus on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, etc. You will regularly communicate with customers to ensure designs meet their requirements and actively manage changes, deviations, and value analysis/value engineering (VA/VE).
cond_0105.responsibilities:
Design and develop new products within established design criteria guidelines to adapt Seating Products to Customer Requirements, with a specific focus on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, etc.
Communicate and manage Changes, Deviations, and VA/VE for Product with Customers on an ongoing basis.
Provide Design and Manage all Program Refreshes or New Programs for Product Design, Testing, and Samples to support a smooth launch with Customer.
Develop CAD generated solid models and engineering drawings in Catia V5. Provide CAD data to develop proof of principle models to verify design concepts for Heating, Heat/Cool, and Heat/Vent Systems, mechanisms, plastic, stampings, etc.
Test Designs and develop designs/corrective actions for insufficient areas of design.
Procure prototype product and capital costs as required.
Coordinate the testing of existing and new products to validate FMVSS and customer requirements.
Develop and maintain the DFMEA and DVPR for Programs and/or changes.
Continuously search for new processes and vendors that will enhance products, improve quality, and reduce costs for Electrical Control Units, Switches, Wiring Harness, Blowers, etc.
Apply value-added practices to current products, processes, methods, and materials to identify opportunities for cost/quality improvements.
Support quality and environmental systems and APQP standards in design engineering functions.
Support root cause analysis of quality issues and validate corrective actions when needed.
Coordinate cross-functional team activities between engineering and other departments, regularly connecting with colleagues to keep projects aligned.
Travel as needed to facilities, Suppliers, and Customer locations.
Communicate clearly and persuasively with stakeholders, present numerical data effectively and accurately, and speak up early when issues arise.
Respect cultural differences and promote a harassment-free environment, working with integrity and ethically following [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures.
Prioritize and plan work activities efficiently, consistently arriving at work and meetings on time, and offering help when needed.
Bring people together to work as a team to support projects and programs, collaborating with others to improve overall standards of performance and service.
Manage multiple tasks under tight timelines and participate in projects while assuming additional tasks as assigned.
Identify and resolve problems in a timely manner, initiating discussions with relevant team members to develop solutions to issues.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Automotive or related seat design experience preferred.
Competency in CAD (Preferably Catia V5).
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, and customers.

The role centers on collaborating with cross-functional teams to design and develop new products, with a focus on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, and related components. Together, the team works to ensure designs meet established guidelines and customer requirements. Coordinating on changes, deviations, and value analysis/value engineering (VA/VE) with customers is a key part of how this role operates.
cond_0189.responsibilities:
Work with the team to design and develop new products within established design criteria guidelines, adapting Seating Products to Customer Requirements, with a focus on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, etc.
Coordinate with customers to communicate and manage Changes, Deviations, and VA/VE for Products.
Support and manage all Program Refreshes or New Programs for Product Design, Testing, and Samples, working alongside relevant teams to help ensure a smooth customer launch.
Develop CAD solid models and engineering drawings in Catia V5. Share CAD data with the team to develop proof of principle models and verify design concepts for Heating, Heat/Cool, and Heat/Vent Systems, mechanisms, plastic, stampings, etc.
Test designs and work with others to develop corrective actions for insufficient areas of design.
Coordinate procurement of prototype product and capital costs as required.
Work with the team to test existing and new products to validate FMVSS and customer requirements.
Develop and maintain the DFMEA and DVPR for Programs and/or changes in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
Collaborate with suppliers and internal teams to identify new processes and vendors that will enhance products, improve quality, and reduce costs for Electrical Control Units, Switches, Wiring Harness, Blowers, etc.
Work with the team to apply value-added practices to current products, processes, methods, and materials to identify opportunities for cost/quality improvements.
Support quality and environmental systems and APQP standards in design engineering functions.
Assist in root cause analysis of quality issues and help validate corrective actions when needed.
Coordinate cross-functional team activities between engineering and other departments.
Travel as needed to facilities, Suppliers, and Customer locations.
Communicate clearly and persuasively, present numerical data effectively and accurately, and maintain composure under stressful situations.
Respect cultural differences and promote a harassment-free environment, working with integrity and ethically following [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures.
Plan and prioritize work activities efficiently, arrive at work and meetings on time, and offer help to others when needed.
Work alongside others as a team to support projects and programs, contributing to overall standards of performance and service.
Manage multiple tasks under tight timelines and participate in projects while taking on additional tasks as assigned.
Identify and resolve problems in a timely manner, working with the team to understand root causes and develop solutions.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0189.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree (B.S.) in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) from a four-year college or university; and/or 2-5+ years' related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Basic understanding of APQP, PPAP, and continuous improvement such as Kaizen or 6-Sigma.
Competency in CAD (preferably Catia V5).
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, and customers.
Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as stress analysis, kinematics, probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
Preferred Requirements
Automotive or related seat design experience.
Knowledge of AX, Mapics, and Microsoft Office software (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

The role primarily involves designing and developing new products, particularly focusing on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, etc. The successful candidate will ensure adherence to established design criteria guidelines to meet customer requirements. Effective communication and management of changes, deviations, and value analysis/value engineering (VA/VE) for products with customers are essential aspects of this role. Coordinate the testing of existing and new products to validate FMVSS and customer requirements.

Coordinate cross-functional team activities between engineering and other departments.

Maintain composure under stressful situations, communicate clearly and persuasively, and present numerical data effectively and accurately.

cond_0395.responsibilities:
Design and develop new products within established design criteria guidelines to adapt Seating Products to Customer Requirements, with a specific focus on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, etc.
Lead communication and management of Changes, Deviations, and VA/VE for Product with Customers.
Direct all Program Refreshes or New Programs for Product Design, Testing, and Samples to ensure a smooth launch with Customer.
Develop CAD generated solid models and engineering drawings in Catia V5. Deliver CAD data to develop proof of principle models to verify design concepts for Heating, Heat/Cool, and Heat/Vent Systems, mechanisms, plastic, stampings, etc.
Test Designs and drive corrective actions for insufficient areas of design.
Procure prototype product and capital costs as required.
Own the testing of existing and new products to validate FMVSS and customer requirements.
Develop and maintain the DFMEA and DVPR for Programs and/or changes.
Proactively identify new processes and vendors that will enhance products, improve quality, and reduce costs for Electrical Control Units, Switches, Wiring Harness, Blowers, etc.
Apply value-added practices to current products, processes, methods, and materials to identify opportunities for cost/quality improvements.
Drive quality and environmental systems and APQP standards in design engineering functions.
Lead root cause analysis of quality issues and validate corrective actions when needed.
Direct cross-functional team activities between engineering and other departments.
Travel as needed to facilities, Suppliers, and Customer locations.
Maintain composure under stressful situations, communicate clearly and persuasively, and present numerical data effectively and accurately.
Respect cultural differences and promote a harassment-free environment, working with integrity and ethically following [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures.
Prioritize and plan work activities efficiently, consistently arriving at work and meetings on time, and offering help when needed.
Lead others to work as a team to support projects and programs, demonstrating teamwork by collaborating with others to improve overall standards of performance and service.
Manage multiple tasks under tight timelines and take on additional tasks as assigned.
Identify and resolve problems in a timely manner, applying root cause analysis to develop solutions to issues.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0395.requirements:
Bachelor's degree (B.S.) in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) from a four-year college or university; and/or 2-5+ years' related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Basic understanding of APQP, PPAP, and continuous improvement such as Kaizen or 6-Sigma.
Automotive or related seat design experience preferred.
Competency in CAD (Preferably Catia V5).
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, and customers.
Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as stress analysis, kinematics, probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
Knowledge of CAD (Catia V5 preferred), AX, Mapics, and Microsoft Office software (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
cond_0395.values: We value ambition, achievement, and consistent follow-through. We believe strong outcomes come from maintaining high expectations for the work we do.

Come join us and help us build a global company where we're all proud to belong. Confidence can sometimes hold women back from applying for a job. So, whatever your background and wherever you come from, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

cond_0475.intro: We are looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer to join our team. The role primarily involves designing and developing new products, with a focus on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, and similar components. The successful candidate will ensure adherence to established design criteria guidelines to meet customer requirements. Managing changes, deviations, and value analysis/value engineering (VA/VE) for products is an essential part of this role.
cond_0475.responsibilities:
Design and develop new products within established design criteria guidelines to adapt Seating Products to Customer Requirements, with a specific focus on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, etc.
Document and manage Changes, Deviations, and VA/VE for Product, sharing updates with Customers as required.
Manage all Program Refreshes or New Programs for Product Design, Testing, and Samples to support a smooth launch, coordinating with Customer on relevant deliverables.
Develop CAD generated solid models and engineering drawings in Catia V5. Provide CAD data to develop proof of principle models to verify design concepts for Heating, Heat/Cool, and Heat/Vent Systems, mechanisms, plastic, stampings, etc.
Test Designs and develop designs/corrective actions for insufficient areas of design.
Procure prototype product and capital costs as required.
Coordinate the testing of existing and new products to validate FMVSS and customer requirements.
Develop and maintain the DFMEA and DVPR for Programs and/or changes.
Research new processes and vendors that will enhance products, improve quality, and reduce costs for Electrical Control Units, Switches, Wiring Harness, Blowers, etc.
Apply value-added practices to current products, processes, methods, and materials to identify opportunities for cost/quality improvements.
Support quality and environmental systems and APQP standards in design engineering functions.
Support root cause analysis of quality issues and validate corrective actions when needed.
Interface with engineering and other departments to coordinate cross-functional activities tied to project milestones.
Travel as needed to facilities, Suppliers, and Customer locations.
Communicate clearly and accurately, including presenting numerical data in written and verbal reporting.
Respect cultural differences and promote a harassment-free environment, working with integrity and ethically following [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures.
Prioritize and plan work activities efficiently, consistently arriving at work and meetings on time.
Support projects and programs by contributing to team efforts and helping maintain overall standards of performance and service.
Manage multiple tasks under tight timelines and take on additional tasks as assigned.
Identify and resolve problems in a timely manner, applying root cause analysis to develop solutions.
Perform other duties as assigned.

The role primarily involves designing and developing new products, particularly focusing on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, etc. The successful candidate will ensure adherence to established design criteria guidelines to meet customer requirements. Effective communication and management of changes, deviations, and value analysis/value engineering (VA/VE) for products with customers are essential aspects of this role.
cond_0489.responsibilities:
Design and develop new products within established design criteria guidelines to adapt Seating Products to Customer Requirements, with a specific focus on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, etc.
Communicate and manage Changes, Deviations, and VA/VE for Product with Customers.
Provide Design and Manage all Program Refreshes or New Programs for Product Design, Testing, and Samples to support a smooth launch with Customer.
Develop CAD generated solid models and engineering drawings in Catia V5. Provide CAD data to develop proof of principle models to verify design concepts for Heating, Heat/Cool, and Heat/Vent Systems, mechanisms, plastic, stampings, etc.
Test Designs and develop designs/corrective actions for insufficient areas of design.
Procure prototype product and capital costs as required.
Coordinate the testing of existing and new products to validate FMVSS and customer requirements.
Develop and maintain the DFMEA and DVPR for Programs and/or changes.
Continuously search for new processes and vendors that will enhance products, improve quality, and reduce costs for Electrical Control Units, Switches, Wiring Harness, Blowers, etc.
Apply value-added practices to current products, processes, methods, and materials to identify opportunities for cost/quality improvements.
Support quality and environmental systems and APQP standards in design engineering functions.
Support root cause analysis of quality issues and validate corrective actions when needed.
Coordinate cross-functional team activities between engineering and other departments.
Travel as needed to facilities, Suppliers, and Customer locations.
Maintain composure under stressful situations, communicate clearly and persuasively, and present numerical data effectively and accurately.
Respect cultural differences and promote a harassment-free environment, working with integrity and ethically following the Company's policies and procedures.
Prioritize and plan work activities efficiently, consistently arriving at work and meetings on time, and offering help when needed.
Lead others to work as a team to support projects and programs, demonstrating teamwork by collaborating with others to improve overall standards of performance and service.
Ability to work under tight timelines while managing multiple tasks and participate in projects while assuming additional tasks as assigned.
Identify and resolve problems in a timely manner, understanding root cause analysis to develop solutions to issues.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0489.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Around 2–5 years of related experience and/or training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Familiarity with APQP, PPAP, and continuous improvement approaches such as Kaizen or 6-Sigma.
Working knowledge of CAD, preferably Catia V5.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures, professional journals, business periodicals, or governmental regulations.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as stress analysis, kinematics, probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
Comfort with Microsoft Office software (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
Preferred Requirements
Automotive or related seat design experience.
Experience with AX and Mapics software.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, and customers.

cond_0504.intro: We are looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer to join our team. The role primarily involves collaborating on the design and development of new products, with a focus on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, etc. The successful candidate will help ensure adherence to established design criteria guidelines to meet customer requirements. Coordinating with customers on changes, deviations, and value analysis/value engineering (VA/VE) is an essential part of this role.
cond_0504.responsibilities:
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and develop new products within established design criteria guidelines, adapting Seating Products to Customer Requirements, with a specific focus on Printed Circuit Boards, Electrical Control Units, Wiring Harness, Switches, etc.
Coordinate with customers to communicate and manage Changes, Deviations, and VA/VE for Product.
Support the design and coordinate all Program Refreshes or New Programs for Product Design, Testing, and Samples to help ensure a smooth launch with Customer.
Develop CAD generated solid models and engineering drawings in Catia V5. Work with the team to develop proof of principle models to verify design concepts for Heating, Heat/Cool, and Heat/Vent Systems, mechanisms, plastic, stampings, etc.
Test Designs and work with others to develop designs/corrective actions for insufficient areas of design.
Procure prototype product and capital costs as required.
Coordinate the testing of existing and new products with relevant stakeholders to validate FMVSS and customer requirements.
Develop and maintain the DFMEA and DVPR for Programs and/or changes in coordination with the team.
Work with suppliers and internal teams to identify new processes and vendors that will enhance products, improve quality, and reduce costs for Electrical Control Units, Switches, Wiring Harness, Blowers, etc.
Apply value-added practices to current products, processes, methods, and materials to identify opportunities for cost/quality improvements.
Support quality and environmental systems and APQP standards in design engineering functions.
Assist with root cause analysis of quality issues and help validate corrective actions when needed.
Coordinate cross-functional team activities between engineering and other departments.
Travel as needed to facilities, Suppliers, and Customer locations.
Communicate clearly and persuasively, and present numerical data effectively and accurately.
Respect cultural differences and promote a harassment-free environment, working with integrity and ethically following [Company name masked]'s policies and procedures.
Prioritize and plan work activities efficiently, consistently arriving at work and meetings on time, and offering help when needed.
Work with others as a team to support projects and programs, collaborating to improve overall standards of performance and service.
Manage multiple tasks under tight timelines and participate in projects while assuming additional tasks as assigned.
Identify and resolve problems in a timely manner, sharing root cause analysis findings to develop solutions with the team.
Perform other duties as assigned.
cond_0504.requirements:
Bachelor's degree (B.S.) in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) from a four-year college or university; and/or 2-5+ years' related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Basic understanding of APQP, PPAP, and continuous improvement such as Kaizen or 6-Sigma.
Automotive or related seat design experience preferred.
Competency in CAD (Preferably Catia V5).
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations.
Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, and customers.
Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as stress analysis, kinematics, probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry.
Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
Knowledge of CAD (Catia V5 preferred), AX, Mapics, and Microsoft Office software (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
